verdict.rationale: Reflect has no explicit no-training policy or opt-out. The only relevant evidence is indirect: its end-to-end encryption claim that 'no one else can read them (not even us)' implies the vendor cannot train on note contents. Two things undercut that protection: uploaded files and images are not end-to-end encrypted, and its AI features send content to OpenAI (GPT-4o) and Anthropic (Claude) without any stated no-training terms. Missing for 10: an explicit policy that user data is not used for model training, a user-facing training opt-out, documented no-training terms with the OpenAI/Anthropic model providers, and coverage of non-encrypted files and images.
